name: Youth Corps (Helena, Missoula, Flathead)
what_you_do: Montana teens ages 17 to 18 work on conservation projects with a crew. The job lasts a full summer of about 8 weeks.
who_can_apply: Montana teens ages 17 to 18. Montana residency is required. You must commit to the full summer.
pay_detail: Living allowance of $1,200 every two weeks before taxes, plus an AmeriCorps education award ($1,565.08 for the 2026 crews).
duration: About 8 weeks (2026 crews: mid June to early August)
deadline_text: Applications are closed for 2026. 2027 youth program applications typically open in February. The page says 2026 interviews began early April.
how_to_apply: Online application. A parent or guardian must sign the Youth Program Release that is emailed after you submit. Interview, then a decision within 2 weeks. Email youthprograms@mtcorps.org with questions.
notes: 2026 crews were in Helena, Kalispell (Flathead Youth Corps) and Missoula. Participants must commit to the full summer. Next dates not posted yet.
